issues.title: Only show server disconnect warning if not open
issues.body:
When the "Server down" test fails, we show an update on every call.  Plus, they happen too frequently (being handled separately in #858).

![screencast](https://i.gyazo.com/71e84bbb9297e9a2489d37fe3d0ceea6.gif)

Faster video [here](https://i.gyazo.com/71e84bbb9297e9a2489d37fe3d0ceea6.mp4)

This means the user ends up with a `stack` of `Check connection` dialogs that all have to be closed.

We should only show the dialog if there isn't one there already.

Plus, we should cancel (close) the dialog if there is a successful ping.
